checkedAlternates.risk: A Moka Pot makes strong espresso-like coffee.
checkedAlternates.resolution: A Moka Pot generates ~1.5–2 bar of steam pressure (group-1), far below the ~9 bar required for true espresso (group-2).

checkedAlternates.risk: French Press uses a mesh filter.
checkedAlternates.resolution: French Press steeps grounds in full water immersion before plunging (group-3), rather than gravity percolation through a filter bed (group-4).

authorReview.notes: Author factual, ambiguity, and three-locale review complete.
